holder-quote: I believe the term is [Aeromancer], Ksmvr. And asking about inferiority and superiority is considered a social flaw in most circumstances.
The [Aeromancer] was nodding eagerly, forgetting the others as she talked craft while Ksmvr tried to explain what an Antinium was, from his perspective.
I’m good with a staff, but as an [Aeromancer] I find it’s hard to avoid electrifying metal.
This time both Ceria and Yvlon frowned. Stan and Alais? The man looked down at the [Aeromancer] and cleared his throat.
She looked at Alais. The [Aeromancer] avoided looking at Ceria.
Alais. Ceria shot a blast of snow, but the [Aeromancer] shot lightning back.
Crossbow Stan. The man was talking to Alais, the [Aeromancer] and Silver-rank Captain Ksmvr had been introduced to.
Ksmvr looked at Alais. The [Aeromancer] appeared uncomfortable.
Why is he not a high-level adventurer, then, Captain Alais?
Ceria blinked. She looked at Yvlon. The armored woman stared at Alais.
His team slowed. Two ran on, but the rest came back. Alais’ team slowed as well. The [Aeromancer] raised her staff.
Alais was checking her staff, electricity running down it. Yvlon sidled away; the [Aeromancer]’s control was poor and her lightning was trying to earth itself on her armor. Pelico grimaced.
The two adventurer captains stiffened. Alais opened her mouth.

He led them at a slow trot back towards the road. The adventurers moved in weary silence, a few speculating about leveling up, or muttering jokes. Talking. They were all more easy around each other, having fought together. Ceria was complimenting Alais’ spells. The [Aeromancer] grinned.
Alais stared at the half-Elf. Ceria stared back at the [Aeromancer].
Alais turned towards her. The [Aeromancer] hesitated.

Captain Xenic chuckled to himself as his ship sailed at speed towards Wistram. He also had an [Aeromancer] on board and he could have outrun or caught The Emerald Signet if he chose. But he was a [Merchant]; he didn’t rob ships, even if he thought he could have taken the treasure.
Ryoka Griffin. Alias: Wind Runner of Reizmelt.
